copy.en:
Dry-Wet Separation For Better Packing
A dedicated wet-dry bag keeps damp garments apart from other packed clothes.
Polyester lining, two compartments, X-shaped straps
Four side hooks plus one top metal hook
copy.zh:
干湿分离，行李更整齐
独立干湿袋让湿衣物与其他衣物分开放置
涤纶内衬、双区分隔与X型固定带
侧面四个挂钩及上方金属挂钩
copy.de:
Nass- und Trockenfach für Ordnung
Das separate Nassfach hält feuchte Kleidung von anderer Kleidung getrennt.
Polyesterfutter, zwei Bereiche, X-förmige Packgurte
Vier Seitenhaken plus ein Metallhaken oben
copy.fr:
Compartiment sec-humide, rangement séparé
La poche dédiée sépare les vêtements humides des autres vêtements rangés.
Doublure polyester, deux zones, sangles en X
Quatre crochets latéraux et un crochet métallique supérieur
copy.it:
Scomparto asciutto-umido, ordine separato
La tasca dedicata tiene gli indumenti umidi separati dagli altri capi.
Fodera in poliestere, due scomparti, cinghie a X
Quattro ganci laterali più un gancio metallico superiore
copy.es:
Compartimento seco-húmedo, mejor orden
El bolsillo específico separa la ropa húmeda del resto de prendas.
Forro de poliéster, dos compartimentos, correas en X
Cuatro ganchos laterales y un gancho metálico superior

design_brief_zh: 主卖点是干湿分离袋，购买理由是让湿衣物与其他衣物分开放置；以打开的行李箱内部作为主要证据，不使用无法验证的静音或性能承诺。PC画布1464×600，左侧产品区[0.05,0.08,0.46,0.84]：采用箱体三分之二侧前方角度，箱盖打开，清晰展示涤纶内衬、干湿分离袋、双区分隔和X型固定带；箱体侧面保留四个挂钩，并用局部放大视图展示上方金属挂钩。右侧文案区[0.57,0.10,0.38,0.80]，自上而下对应四行：第1行标题突出干湿分离；第2行说明湿衣物与其他衣物分开；第3行标注涤纶内衬、双区分隔和X型固定带；第4行标注四个侧面挂钩及一个上方金属挂钩。德语文本右侧预留约20%横向扩展空间。移动端1200×900，上方产品与场景区[0.08,0.05,0.84,0.53]，下方文案区[0.05,0.64,0.90,0.31]，按标题、说明、两条细节重新堆叠，不能遮挡箱体内部。可在左侧场景边缘加入不抢主视觉的360°八轮、折叠手机支架和水杯架实物细节，但不标注静音。使用欧洲现代旅行摄影、低饱和中性色和自然侧光，真实呈现聚碳酸酯/ABS箱体、铝合金框架与竖条纹表面，避免夸张反光。字体采用Arial、Helvetica或Amazon Ember风格无衬线字体，标题加粗，细节和数字清晰易读。当前证据未提供轮子静音性能，因此图片和文案均不得暗示静音；也未提供额外容量或适配承诺，避免补充此类信息。
compliance_note_zh: 仅使用已提供的干湿分离袋、湿衣物与其他衣物分开放置、涤纶内衬、双区分隔、X型固定带、侧面四个挂钩和上方一个金属挂钩事实。不得宣称静音、绝对耐用、官方认证、全球适配、特定航空公司适配或其他未提供的性能。图片应准确呈现真实结构，不添加竞品标识、虚构图标、评分、促销信息、容量承诺或未经证实的对比结论。
image_prompt_en: Create a premium Amazon A+ carousel visual for the YWJ 13A travel suitcase, with no rendered text, letters, numbers, logos, badges, icons, or promotional graphics. Use a 1464×600 desktop composition and a separate 1200×900 mobile composition. Desktop: place an open suitcase at a three-quarter side-front angle in the left region, approximately x=0.05, y=0.08, w=0.46, h=0.84. Clearly show the polyester lining, wet-dry separation bag, two interior compartments, and X-shaped packing straps. Keep the four side hooks visible and add a realistic close-up inset of the single metal hook on top. Reserve a clean, uncluttered text-free area on the right at x=0.57, y=0.10, w=0.38, h=0.80 for four copy lines in reading order: wet-dry separation headline, separation benefit, interior evidence, hook evidence. Mobile: place the product and travel scene in the upper region x=0.08, y=0.05, w=0.84, h=0.53, with the entire text-free copy area below at x=0.05, y=0.64, w=0.90, h=0.31. Use low-saturation neutral European travel photography, natural side light, restrained reflections, and a modern business-travel setting. Show authentic polycarbonate/ABS shell, aluminum frame, and vertical shell ridges. Optional secondary edge details may show the 360-degree eight-wheel assembly, foldable phone holder, and foldable cup holder, but do not visually imply silent performance. Emphasize the wet-dry bag and interior organization as the primary visual proof; hooks are the supporting proof. Use realistic scale, accurate construction, no exaggerated features, and leave all copy areas blank for later typesetting.
